# NFL Daily — 2026-08-06 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- 08/06: Colts agree to a two-year, $44M extension (up to $47M, $39M guaranteed) with RB Jonathan Taylor — the richest third contract for a running back ever. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49544515/jonathan-taylor-agree-2-year-44m-extension-colts)
- 08/05: Falcons lock up their offensive core, extending RB Bijan Robinson along with WR Drake London, TE Kyle Pitts, and OL Matthew Bergeron. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49528788/atlanta-falcons-sign-bijan-robinson-offensive-core-put-spotlight-qb)
- 08/05: Commanders agree to sign free-agent WR Stefon Diggs on a one-year, $12M deal. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7088680/2026/08/05/commanders-stefon-diggs-contract-nfl-news/)
- 08/06: Falcons edge rusher Jalon Walker will miss the 2026 season with a torn ACL. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49531025/sources-falcons-jalon-walker-feared-torn-acl)
- 08/05: Ravens sign WR Zay Flowers to a four-year extension, keeping their top receiver under contract through 2031. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49539209/zay-flowers-hoping-ravens-extend-qb-lamar-jackson)
- 08/06: Aaron Donald takes another step toward an NFL return, working out in pads for the Rams. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/aaron-donald-works-out-for-the-rams-in-latest-step-on-comeback-path-nfl-football)
